notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 [b]Fixes and Improvements:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the bug where [b]boxes would spawn inside each other[/b], fly away, or not appear at all.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several [b]tutorial issues[/b], including tutorials that would freeze or were missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where [b]customers would stack on top of each other[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where [b]customers would get stuck indefinitely asking for products[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where [b]interaction messages appeared on boxes, but interaction only worked after dropping them on the ground[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the [b]objective text overlapped with items[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]shopping cart total value[/b], which was incorrect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where [b]customers took too long to appear[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the [b]door wouldn't respond to interactions[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug with [b]opening and closing boxes[/b], which was not working correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]button to remove items from shopping carts[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]screen resolution settings and windowed/fullscreen mode[/b].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you all for the amazing feedback!
I’m working hard to make the game more stable, polished, and fun. If you find more bugs or have suggestions, feel free to share them! 🚀[/p]

tags.bug: Fixed the bug where boxes would spawn inside each other, fly away, or not appear at all.
Fixed several tutorial issues, including tutorials that would freeze or were missing.
Fixed the bug where customers would stack on top of each other.
Fixed the bug where customers would get stuck indefinitely asking for products.
Fixed the issue where interaction messages appeared on boxes, but interaction only worked after dropping them on the ground.
Fixed the bug where the objective text overlapped with items.
Fixed the shopping cart total value, which was incorrect.
Fixed the bug where customers took too long to appear.
Fixed the bug where the door wouldn't respond to interactions.
Fixed the bug with opening and closing boxes, which was not working correctly.

tags.feature: Added a button to remove items from shopping carts.
Added screen resolution settings and windowed/fullscreen mode.
